<function name="GetIsToggle" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns whether the toggle functionality is enabled for a label. Set with <page>DLabel:SetIsToggle</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether or not toggle functionality is enabled.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
